description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Join a small, in-person engineering group as a full stack engineer, taking responsibility for significant parts of a software platform. You will work across backend services, third-party integrations and user-facing features, and help shape technical direction with company leadership.
 What you'll do
 - Design, build and release major product features from first concept to live deployment.
 - Develop and maintain low-latency backend infrastructure, improving performance, reliability and support for more intricate workflows.
 - Build and maintain integrations between the platform and external software systems.
 - Collaborate directly with users to understand their day-to-day processes and shape them into clear, dependable product experiences.
 - Take ownership of broad areas of the codebase with real autonomy and help make architecture decisions.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 1 to 3 years of software engineering experience with solid fundamentals across the full stack.
 - Good product instincts about what to build and how it should feel for the user.
 - Ability to bring structure to unclear requirements and deliver practical, working software with a strong sense of ownership.
 - Eagerness to pick up any part of the stack needed to get the job done, including productive use of AI coding assistants.
 - Ability to work on-site in San Francisco.
 Bonus points
 - Experience tuning and scaling Postgres databases.
 - Experience building and operating production systems.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 160,000 to 220,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Bonus
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site
 - Full-time
